payload.title: Qualify custody-aware cleanup and recovery of ignored execution artifacts
payload.summary: The canonical checkout retains local archives, preserved historical checkout evidence, failed/native worker traces and generated caches. Existing reconciliation documents describe same-SSD restore packets; current metadata finds residual preserved-checkout directories and permission-denied regions. Qualify exact ownership, unique evidence, restore manifests, future recovery requirements and a bounded cleanup allowlist before deleting anything.

discovery.reference: Codex source-backed reconciliation audit at 3c09641dd17b13b83c2fe84e3f1cf4920ca7186f; documentation/intake-only assignment, 2026-10-23

payload.benefit: Allow later repository hygiene without destroying frozen outcomes, unknown failed-run evidence or the only local restore packet; improve successor-session recoverability.
payload.uncertainty: No deletion or ACL change is authorized by capture. External/off-volume backups were not inspected. Existing archive restoration claims are historical and were not rerun. Cache-looking paths may be inside evidence packets; unreadable contents remain unqualified.
